name: Suspicious Child Process Of Veeam Dabatase
description: Detects suspicious child processes of the Veeam service process. This could indicate potential RCE or SQL Injection.
author: GAI_CTI
query: (process.parent.executable:*\\sqlservr.exe AND process.parent.command_line:*VEEAMSQL*) AND (((process.executable:(*\\cmd.exe OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\wsl.exe OR *\\wt.exe)) AND (process.command_line:(*\-ex\ * OR *bypass* OR *cscript* OR *DownloadString* OR *http\:\/\/* OR *https\:\/\/* OR *mshta* OR *regsvr32* OR *rundll32* OR *wscript* OR *copy\ *))) OR (process.executable:(*\\net.exe OR *\\net1.exe OR *\\netstat.exe OR *\\nltest.exe OR *\\ping.exe OR *\\tasklist.exe OR *\\whoami.exe)))
